description:
This week's weather and extreme-weather risk at a place, day by day: temperature, rain, wind and each day's risk class (Very low, Low, Medium, High, Critical) with the hazard behind it and why. Heat and cold are graded on UTCI, the felt temperature outdoors.

Use for the next 7 days: "will it storm in Lisbon on Friday", "is it too hot to hike this week". Days 8 and later: assess_place with dates. Disasters already happening: get_hazards_near. Long-term exposure: get_climate_profile.

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give

name: get_forecast

attribution.description: The credit the licence asks for when it is retold

name.description: The feed's name as it is cited

air_temperature_max.description: For heat and cold, the highest air temperature beside the UTCI; null otherwise

limit.description: Set where the value is past the end of the ladder and is only a bound

value.description: The value that set the class

value_max.description: The highest value the stored class allows; null when open

value_min.description: The lowest value the stored class allows; null when open

variable.description: utci, the felt temperature in full sun; wind_gust_10m; or precip_intensity_mmh

partial.description: True when the forecast window starts or ends inside the day

risk.description: The day's highest risk; null when no step of the day is graded

step_hours.description: Hours between the day's steps: 1, 3 or 6

variable.description: utci, the felt temperature; wind_gust_10m; or precip_intensity_mmh

class.description: The class's place in risk_scale, from 0; null where the forecast holds no value

driver.description: The value, threshold and air temperature behind the class

explanation.description: The class in words, built from the driver

hazard.description: The hazard behind the class; null at the lowest

level.description: The class, as risk_scale names it; null where it holds no value

local_time.description: When in the day the class peaks

reading.description: The physical reading behind the class

class.description: The class the value falls in, as risk_scale names it

to.description: Where the next class begins; null at the top class

Truncated.description: Set when an answer was held under its size: the tail of its main list left out.

field.description: The answer's list that was cut

left_out.description: How many of its entries, the least important, were left out

left_out_names.description: Each entry left out, where the list is not ordered by importance

why.description: The limit, and how to ask for the rest

credit.description: How a retelling credits the answer: Source: Criora with a link to the page the answer is about, then each originator whose data it quotes in the words its licence asks for. Concise, each credit once; detailed, by source with its name and licence, criora first

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given

truncated.description: Absent unless the answer was cut to fit

title: 7-day weather forecast and extreme-weather risk
